title: Balanced velocity-within-occupancy sensitivity for LLZTO at 800 K
research_question: At 800 K, is between-occupancy transport variation distinguishable from within-occupancy velocity-initialization variation?
primary_estimands: between-occupancy variance of log tracer diffusivity
within-occupancy velocity variance of log tracer diffusivity
between-occupancy variance of log collective diffusivity
within-occupancy velocity variance of log collective diffusivity
between-occupancy and within-occupancy variance of the log collective-to-tracer ratio
stopping_rule: All 15 planned 800 K cells (five occupancies times three velocity initializations, including five reference points from the primary campaign) remain in the analysis. An unresolved point blocks the corresponding estimator rather than being dropped.

design.analysis_role: Balanced nested variance decomposition at 800 K only; it does not identify separate occupancy and velocity effects for full Arrhenius activation energies.

gates.criterion: Run only after the full universal-potential domain gate passes.
Every occupancy has exactly three matched 20 ps equilibration plus 500 ps production points at 800 K, and unresolved estimator-specific points are not removed.
